name: Carolina 1
subtitle: Zone offense: screen entry into the 2-1-2
goal: Use a screen up top to get into our Carolina spots with the zone already moving.
options: Best: 5 open at the nail after the roll. Next: run Carolina from here.

steps.note: 5 comes up from the wing and screens the top defender.
1 dribbles off the screen to one side. 5 rolls to the nail. 2 fills back to the other guard spot.
Now we are in Carolina (2-1-2). Same rules: ball to the corner, the nail dives, the weak side flashes.
